svg.title: Heat over the whole floor
svg.desc: The settled temperature at a worm's nose over the floor, from the world's air on its grid (heat.rs, air.rs): the floor holds its thermal map, the six energy pillars are held warm, risers are walls and the open air is at the ambient. Left the default world (a level floor at 20 degrees Celsius), right the thermotaxis assay's gradient of 0.5 degrees Celsius per centimetre along x.
svg.text: Heat over the whole floor: the pillars and the floor's gradient
Settled field (90 s in), excess over the ambient at nose height, one sample per 2 m column; pillars held 10 K warm (a chosen setting)
--floor-gradient 0.5: the assay's 0.5 °C per cm (44.8 m), warmer to +x
Magenta squares: the energy pillars. The floor holds the air near it
to its own temperature; a pillar's warmth reaches a worm's nose
